==Low profile==
Ezio is naturally in low profile, where most actions won't alert guards and he won't attract any undue attention.

{| {{controlstable}}
! PlayStation 3/4
! Xbox 360/One
! PC
!Nintendo Switch
! Action
|-
| {{psx|S}} || {{xbox|X}} || {{mouse|l}}
|
| {{desc}} Draw or swing weapons or fists
|-
| {{psx|C}} || {{xbox|B}} || {{kbd|Shift}}
|
| {{desc}} Gentle push
|-
| {{psx|X}} || {{xbox|A}} || {{kbd|Space}}
|
| {{desc}} Fast walk or steal
|}

==High profile==
When in high profile, Ezio can perform more athletic and aggressive actions. It is also easier to alert the guards when in high profile.

! Xbox 360/One
! PC
